comment: Kodak VISION3 500T 5219/7219 'Modulation-Transfer Function Curves' (TI2647F), p.3. Vector graph; log-log axes, 1-600 cycles/mm by 1-200 % response. Exposure 3200K tungsten, process ECN-2, Status M. All three curves are drawn in the same near-black solid stroke, so each is told apart by its bounding box: the R line ends highest (about 38 % at 80 c/mm; G about 29 %), B lowest (about 16 %); the R/G/B letters at the line ends confirm this. The curves start at about 2.5 c/mm and end at about 80 c/mm. The x axis is calibrated on the 1 and 100 c/mm gridlines (snapped from their labels), the y axis on the 100 % and 10 % gridlines (y values are percent of response, 100 = unity modulation; the datasheet curves sit slightly above 100 % at mid frequencies because of edge/adjacency enhancement).
